current_version.description: the version the owner runs, as the project tags it

current_found.description: false when the version in use is not a tag of the repository: nothing after it can be listed, and the verdict is incomplete

latest_version.description: the newest version of the owner's series, by version order; the version in use when no newer one could be established (verdict incomplete or up_to_date)

verdict.description: up_to_date: nothing newer in the owner's series; safe: every version in between read in full and none touches an item; changes_needed: a version changes something an item names; incomplete: a version in between was not read or read in part, or the versions could not be listed, never safe

items.description: the items this run checked, each in the owner's words: the depends-on list as learned notes and the run's message change it

versions.description: each version in between whose notes were read, newest first; empty for up_to_date. With unread it accounts for every version in between

source_url.description: a page a person can open that shows its notes: its release page or the changelog

read.description: partial: a slice cut its notes and the rest was not read

findings.description: each change that touches an item on the owner's list

change.description: what changes, in the release note's own words

affects.description: the item it touches, in the owner's words

what_to_do.description: the note's migration step; when it gives none, what the change implies, starting "Not stated in the notes:"

source_url.description: the page that shows the change

confidence.description: high: the note names the item itself; medium: it names the item's parent; low: the match is the agent's reading

other_breaking.description: breaking changes in the releases read that touch nothing on the list, one line each with its version

unread.description: each version in between whose notes were not read, objects never text; several unread for one reason may share an entry ("v2.0.0 to v2.3.1 (9 versions)"); not empty means the verdict is incomplete

reason.description: blocked: a rate limit or an access-denied answer; not_found: no notes for it; error: a timeout or server error; skipped: the fetch budget was spent

unreachable.description: each page the plan needed and could not read, with why, objects never text

reason.description: blocked: a rate limit or an access-denied answer; not_found: no notes for it; error: a timeout or server error; skipped: the fetch budget was spent

detail.description: what the page answered, in a few words: "rate limited (403)", "timed out"

summary.description: the report as a person reads it: the range, the verdict, each finding with what to do, what was not read, what a note or the message changed, what is new since the last report
